_comment: ZAP suppressions read by ci/zap_gate.py. Each entry covers one rule (pluginid) on URLs matching uri_regex, needs a reason, and stops applying after expires. List every entry in docs/SECURITY_GATES.md too.

_example.reason: why this is a false positive

suppressions.reason: Boolean-based SQL injection reported on the {username} path segment of PUT /users/v1/{username}/password. The handler looks the user up with the ORM (User.query.filter_by(username=...)), so no SQL is built from the path; 'name1 AND 1=1 --' returns 400 'User Not Found' and 'name1' returns 204, which ZAP reads as a true/false difference. The real flaw here is PT-03 (any user can change any password), which no ZAP rule detects.
